lead.headline: 0-3, and Achane is still starting
lead.deck: Out for the season, zero in an RB slot. Tuten goes in; Gordon is the claim.
lead.body: De'Von Achane tore his ACL on Sunday and is out for the season, and he's still in AVIATO's starting lineup, which is why ESPN has you at 114.1 against Aye-Aye's 125.3. Start Bhayshul Tuten there and the lineup reaches 126.9. Week 3 was lost 103.8 to 140.6. The best lineup this roster could have fielded scored 137.9, so it wasn't winnable, and the biggest single gap was a brief's coin-flip call, Coker over McLaurin, 3.8 to 19.7. Three starters are questionable: Josh Allen (knee contusion, expected to play), Justin Jefferson (ankle sprain, could play) and Jalen Coker (minor quad strain). Both WR fallbacks lock before Sunday's inactives, so Friday's report decides Jefferson. The Ollie Gordon II claim for Achane clears at 01:00 Wednesday, and AVIATO is first in the order.

doFirst.note: Tuten into Achane's RB slot is a tap you can make today. The McLaurin swap and the Murray add are fallbacks: fire them only on Friday's report or Sunday's inactives. Allen (knee contusion) is expected to play. If he's ruled out, the brief's fallback is a free-agent QB add, which this page can't show as a swap.
